title: Release quest-cli 0.14.2 paired with lore-cli 0.14.2 (ODOC-556)
description: Release cut for the ODOC-556 fixes (QCLI-543, QCLI-545): a patch, 0.14.2, paired with lore-cli 0.14.2 (Article 3). Leader decision. Follows docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md. Before planning the order, measure the publish parity gate with --require: this repo's memory is that quest's publish refuses until lore-cli main reads the same version, whereas the brief said lore's parity reads quest-cli main; the gate decides, not either recollection. Registry steps (staging, latest) are the operator's own dialog, tier 3; no grant or relay moves them.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The metadata PR lands as two commits: the version strings first, then the binary bytes (runbook: What a version bump touches)
The pre-tag gates pass: bun run check:packages and bun run test:packages, the qualification record, and the CHANGELOG has a ## 0.14.2 heading carried by the tagged commit
Tag v0.14.2 is pushed (check the grants and the leader's ruling first) and prepublication-qualification is dispatched against that tag and produces the native-execution receipt for that exact commit
Step 6 rechecks are done (registry name and conflicts, repository identity, lore release gate, package metadata) and the release.yml dry run (publish=false) passes
Staging under release-candidate is the operator's own dialog, tier 3, and is done only after that grant; bun run receipt:verify-published passes against the staged versions
latest moves only on the leader's go, after opum-cli-e2e's pair receipt, as the operator's own dialog, tier 3
